summary: Bank Reconciliation Phase 2 + Phase 3 fully validated. Backend: 6/6 unit tests in test_bank_recon_phase2.py PASSED; 11/11 new HTTP integration tests in test_bank_recon_phase2_integration.py PASSED (including a real Claude /ai-categorize call with CLAUDE_BUDGET=1). Frontend: Bank Reconciliation page renders all 7 new tabs with correct counts, violet AI Categorizer toolbar with both action buttons, file picker accepts .csv/.xls/.xlsx/.pdf, Recent Uploads table shows Matched/Partial/Unmatched/Manual Review/Ignored columns.

issues: Long count rows can wrap on smaller monitors but not blocking; ACTION column right-aligned, MANUAL REVIEW column header runs together as 'MANUALREVIEW' due to text-transform uppercase + no space — minor visual nit.

action_items: (Optional minor) Add a small whitespace in the 'Manual Review' table header label or wrap each word in its own span so the uppercase CSS doesn't collapse it to 'MANUALREVIEW'. Cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: match_transactions() in routes/bank_reconciliation.py returns a clean 6-bucket dict (matched, partially_matched, unmatched_debits, unmatched_credits, ignored, manual_review). The /upload handler correctly derives the legacy 'unrecorded' bucket = unmatched_debits + manual_review-debits so the old UI tab still works.

Dedupe guard in /auto-convert uses (center, date, amount) as the key — correct for this domain since recon is monthly and amounts are exact-numeric. On dupe, the bank transaction is flipped to match_status='matched', match_method='auto_convert_dedupe', matched_expense snapshot stored — verified via integration test.

Claude prompt constrains categories to the active expense_heads master and forces strictly-valid JSON; response is parsed with markdown-fence stripping + regex fallback — robust. Unknown/invalid categories are silently dropped (good — avoids polluting expenses).
/ai-categorize correctly persists ai_suggested_category / ai_confidence / ai_reasoning / ai_categorized_at / ai_categorized_by on bank_transactions; audit row written to expense_reconciliation_log.

Credit-side reconciliation: _load_credit_sources fetches monthly_commissions and matches by (settlement_date, net_settlement_amount) with PG commission (sundry_debtors) carried into matched_credit.pg_commission so the UI can show pay-gateway commission inline.
ATM/cash-withdrawal detection uses keyword + regex against ATM/CASH WDL/CWDL/NWD etc; auto_ignored=true and ignore_reason='Cash Withdrawal' carried to the row.
High-value (>=50k) unknown debit is correctly routed to manual_review instead of unrecorded — verified.
credit_source_hint populated via detect_credit_source() against PHONEPE/RAZORPAY/SWIGGY/ZOMATO/PAYTM etc — verified for Razorpay narration in integration test.

FILE SIZE: routes/bank_reconciliation.py is 1884 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Suggest splitting into recon_match.py (match_transactions + _load_credit_sources + cash-withdrawal), recon_ai.py (ai-categorize + auto-convert), recon_routes.py (HTTP handlers) in a future cleanup pass. Not blocking.
All MongoDB find calls correctly project away _id; no ObjectId leakage observed in any /api/bank-reconciliation/* response.

data-testid coverage on UI is solid: bank-reconciliation-page, br-center-select, br-month-input, br-file-input, br-upload-btn, br-uploads-table, br-summary, br-tab-{unrecorded,partial,matched,credits,manual,added,ignored}, br-ai-toolbar, br-ai-categorize, br-auto-convert, br-bulk-* all present.

Idempotency: /upload always inserts a NEW upload row + bank_transactions for the same file. There is no de-dup at upload level (same CSV uploaded twice creates two upload rows). Auto-convert's per-row dedupe guard mitigates duplicate expenses, but two upload records will exist. Consider adding a SHA256 of the raw bytes + a unique index on (center, month, file_hash) to dedupe re-uploads. Non-blocking for this release.
